en.headline: HKMA grants restricted banking licence to Bakai Bank
en.dek: The Kyrgyz lender's licence took effect on Monday, taking the number of restricted licence banks in Hong Kong to 17.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Monday that the Monetary Authority has granted a restricted banking licence to BAKAI BANK Open Joint Stock Company under the Banking Ordinance. The bank is incorporated in the Kyrgyz Republic, and the licence took effect on 5 October.

After the grant, Hong Kong has 17 restricted licence banks, the Authority said. Invest Hong Kong's director-general welcomed the opening and described it as a further milestone after the Chief Executive's visit to Central Asia in June. The bank will operate in Hong Kong as Bakai Bank Hong Kong Branch.

The director-general said more leading banks along the Belt and Road were setting up or expanding in Hong Kong, and that the new branch could look for openings in offshore renminbi business, international asset and wealth management, and gold trading. The branch's chief executive said Hong Kong was the right base for the bank's cross-border work, and that demand for trade, payments and treasury services along a Central Asia-Asia-Pacific corridor was still not fully met.

The Authority's announcement did not set out the branch's opening hours or the retail products it would offer. A restricted banking licence does not by itself authorise the full range of deposit-taking open to a licensed bank.

zh.headline: 金管局向吉爾吉斯巴凱銀行發出有限制牌照
zh.dek: 牌照星期一生效，本港有限制牌照銀行數目增至17間。
body: 香港金融管理局星期一宣布，金融管理專員已根據《銀行業條例》，向在吉爾吉斯共和國註冊成立的巴凱銀行股份有限公司發出有限制銀行牌照，牌照於10月5日生效。
金管局表示，牌照發出後，本港有限制牌照銀行數目為17間。投資推廣署署長劉凱旋歡迎巴凱銀行落戶，形容這是行政長官李家超今年6月率團出訪中亞後的又一里程碑。該行將以巴凱銀行香港分行名義在本港經營。
劉凱旋說，愈來愈多「一帶一路」沿線的領先銀行在香港設立或擴展業務，新分行有望在離岸人民幣、國際資產及財富管理、黃金交易等領域開拓機會。分行行政總裁馬禮濤表示，香港適合該行的跨境業務，中亞與亞太之間的貿易、支付及財資服務需求仍未充分滿足。
金管局的公布沒有交代分行的營業時間或會提供的零售產品。有限制銀行牌照本身並不等於可經營持牌銀行的全部存款業務。
